version_2_0_0_changes:
## Important Changes
- Project migrated from JavaScript to TypeScript with esBuild for significantly reduced package size
- From unmaintainable code to slightly more maintainable unmaintainable code
- Removed dependency on jQuery
- Added plugins written in Rust to implement more features not supported by Wallpaper Engine
## Bug Fixes
- Attempted to fix wallpaper initialization failure after prolonged sleep using cache
- Fixed configuration issues where some settings required reload to take effect
## New Features
- New plugin features
-- Media integration supports media control (pause / next / previous)
-- Performance monitoring: view current CPU/GPU/memory/network status
-- Dock bar: add what you want to the dock bar for quick launch, supports software, files, websites (website customization in development)
- Audio visualization wave effect: now supports smooth wave peaks
## Optimizations
- Adjusted weather component UI
-- Unified intervals between data for better aesthetics
-- 7-hour forecast supports rotating temperature display
-- Adjusted and optimized 7-hour forecast detailed UI
- Media integration added pause status indicator
- Wallpaper rotation added custom time interval setting
- Separated time and date color rhythms
